title: Ushakovka cadets win international olympiad
summary: The university team took first place in the team event in maritime affairs and navigation.

body.text: A team of cadets from Admiral Ushakov State Maritime University took first place at the international maritime olympiad. The competition included navigation plotting, collision regulations and simulator tasks.
Congratulations to the participants and their mentors!
